svg.text: PLACEHOLDER: replace me with your drawing
When it is seen: measurement of an attenuator (fixed, or a step of a stepped one).
What to draw: like the filter, but with the symbol of an attenuator (the box with the diagonal
bar or the resistor "T / pi" network): P1 at the input, P2 at the output, with the test leads.
Details: do not overdo the colours: it is a simple thing, two wires and the device. If you make
the filter image first, this one will be almost the same: that is fine (only the symbol
Save your drawing with this name (.svg, .png, .jpg or .webp). While this file is here, the program uses its own diagram.
